{"hypotheses": [
{"name": "Composite 1", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high accruals and low book-to-market ratios tend to have lower returns due to overestimation of their financial health, so a composite that combines these factors should earn higher returns.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "Accruals"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "BM"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Mom12m", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 24},
{"name": "Composite 2", 
"mechanism": "Companies with high R&D expenditures and low market-to-book ratios tend to have higher returns due to their innovative potential, so a composite that combines these factors should earn higher returns.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "RD"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "BM"}], "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}, {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.9, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 30},
{"name": "Composite 3", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high idiosyncratic volatility and low momentum tend to have lower returns due to their high risk and low growth potential, so a composite that combines these factors should earn higher returns.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "IdioVolAHT"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "Mom12m"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "BM", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}, {"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "direction": "higher"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 18},
{"name": "Composite 4", 
"mechanism": "Companies with high operating leverage and low financial leverage tend to have higher returns due to their ability to generate cash flow and reduce debt, so a composite that combines these factors should earn higher returns.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "OPLeverage"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "BookLeverage"}], "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "opposite_sign"}, {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.85, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 36},
{"name": "Composite 5", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high return on assets and low market-to-book ratios tend to have higher returns due to their high profitability and undervaluation, so a composite that combines these factors should earn higher returns.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "roaq"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "BM"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "size_segment", "segment": "micro", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Accruals", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}, {"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "direction": "lower"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.75, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 12},
{"name": "Composite 6", 
"mechanism": "Companies with high R&D ability and low idiosyncratic volatility tend to have higher returns due to their innovative potential and low risk, so a composite that combines these factors should earn higher returns.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "RDAbility"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "IdioVolAHT"}], "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}, {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.95, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 42},
{"name": "Composite 7", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high intangible assets and low book-to-market ratios tend to have higher returns due to their high growth potential and undervaluation, so a composite that combines these factors should earn higher returns.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "IntanBM"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "BM"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Mom6m", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}, {"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "direction": "higher"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 24},
{"name": "Composite 8", 
"mechanism": "Companies with high dividend yield and low financial leverage tend to have higher returns due to their high income generation and low risk, so a composite that combines these factors should earn higher returns.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "DivYieldST"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "BookLeverage"}], "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "opposite_sign"}, {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.9, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 36}
]}
